comparison: Compared to empf-v3 (failed model_vae_categorical) and empf-v4 (failed ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal, precision_gaussian_fp32), empf-v5 passed every completed Tier 1 metric check across all 13 counted tasks, isolating dense 2D cuSOLVER SVD contention on five_word_joint_smoke as the sole remaining execution bottleneck.
conclusion: empf-v5 passed all 12 non-word counted Tier 1 gates (including model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard, ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal, and precision_gaussian_fp32) and passed all completed checks on five_word_joint_smoke through step 17,501/20,001, but hit the 900s wall-time cap (INCOMPLETE) under concurrent multi-agent GPU load due to 9 per-step serial cuSOLVER SVD calls on dense 2D matrices.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Combining empf-v4's fixed K = min(max_prototypes, B) small-batch prototype banks, stationary zero-shock normalization, and fused autograd syncs with empf-v3's thermal_decay = 0.92 transport smoothing, cool-gated Born-Infeld batch_gain, and exact Sinkhorn-free discrete-simplex Chamfer residuals clears all Tier 1 gates (including model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard, ring16_acquisition, model_ae_gan_multimodal, and precision_gaussian_fp32/mxfp8) and advances through Tier 2/3 to realize gaussian1d_stability, target_shift_recovery, ring_hold, and ring_extension gains.
next_action: Introduce declared optimizer_dense_profile='newton_schulz_v1' in empf-v6 using DualNorm's guarded 32-iteration cubic Newton-Schulz polar solver (_newton_schulz_polar + _PolarGraphCache) for 2D dense matrices while keeping the empf-v5 formulation unchanged.

study.competing_explanation: If cool-gated Born-Infeld batch_gain = 2.0 at B=64 under thermal_decay = 0.92 leaves B=64 VAEs under-regularized even with fixed K=64 prototype banks, or if Sinkhorn-free discrete-simplex Chamfer residuals alter post-acquisition cooling, empf-v5 will fail model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard, or five_word_joint_hold.
